bugs.title: Missing Sessions Table
bugs.description: Sessions table was not created in database. Schema.sql defines 7 tables but only 6 existed.
bugs.impact: System could not track daily sessions, streaks, or gamification features
bugs.root_cause: Schema.sql was not fully applied to the database
bugs.fix_applied: Executed database/schema.sql to create sessions table with all columns, indexes, and constraints
bugs.verification: All 7 tables now exist, session tracking verified working

bugs.title: INSERT_SESSION Incomplete RETURNING Clause
bugs.description: INSERT_SESSION query returned only (id, session_number, streak_day) but code expected all session fields
bugs.impact: First-time session creation failed with KeyError when accessing patterns_discovered and other stat fields
bugs.root_cause: RETURNING clause specified only 3 fields instead of all columns
bugs.verification: Session creation now returns all fields including stat counters, no KeyError

bugs.title: GET_WEEKLY_PATTERNS SQL Syntax Error
bugs.description: Invalid PostgreSQL syntax: array_agg(DISTINCT unnest(domains_affected)) - cannot nest set-returning functions inside aggregates
bugs.impact: Weekly pattern aggregation query would fail with SQL syntax error
bugs.root_cause: Incorrect use of nested set-returning functions in aggregate expression
bugs.fix_applied: Rewrote using subquery to unnest domains first, then aggregate
bugs.code_after:
(SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT d) FROM (
    SELECT unnest(domains_affected) as d FROM behavioral_patterns
    WHERE DATE(created_at) >= $1 AND DATE(created_at) <= $2
) domains_unnest) as domains
bugs.verification: Weekly pattern query executes successfully with correct domain aggregation
